message.disconnect_confirm: Confirm disconnecting this page from your wallet?
message.connect_confirm: Connecting your MetaMask wallet. This only requests your public address — no impact on your assets.
message.connect_request_permission: MetaMask will open an authorization popup requesting access to your wallet address.
message.connect_no_transaction: Only reads your public address — no on-chain transaction is sent.
message.connect_no_gas: Zero cost — no gas fees are required.
message.connect_no_asset_move: Your assets remain safe and untouched.
message.disconnect_revoke_permission: The page will ask MetaMask to revoke this site's account access permission. If the wallet does not support that request, the page will still clear the local connection state.
message.disconnect_refresh: After disconnecting, refreshing the page will not reconnect automatically. You will need to click "Connect MetaMask" again.
message.disconnect_chain_approval: This does not revoke on-chain token approvals, cancel pending transactions, transfer assets, or delete wallet assets.
message.disconnect_reconnect: When reconnecting, MetaMask may show the account permission confirmation again.

message.disconnect_keep: The following cached data will be kept:
